docs.shortdesc: UOSA IFB 27-01 GAC Treatment Optimization
docs.longdesc: Phase 1 of the GAC Treatment Optimization Project includes, but is not limited to, retrofitting one L/2 Building carbon contactor, consisting of two cells, to serve as the per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) pilot study system; restoring upflow and downflow  operating capability through modifications to the existing underdrain  nozzle system; and implementing a proof-of-concept evaluation for carbon transfer improvements. docs.shortdesc: IFB 26-2519, Rental Car Connector
docs.longdesc: The construction of a two-story connector providing interior connectivity between the Terminal Building and the Rental Car Garage with a new direct connection to the departures/ticketing level of the Terminal Building. The rental car counters are being relocated to an expanded north baggage claim area, providing more intuitive access to rental car companies. The Wayfinding signage will be modified to improve circulation, and all lighting in both the north and south baggage claim areas will be replaced with new LED lighting. At the radial center point of the connector will be an outdoor pocket park with new hardscape and softscape, seating, interactive displays, as well as accommodations for a future food truck.

docs.shortdesc: On-Call Consultant Engineering Services RFP (2027014-PU-P)
docs.longdesc: The purpose of this Request for Proposal (RFP) by the City of Harrisonburg, Virginia (City) is to solicit sealed proposals from interested Professional Consultant Engineering Firms (Offeror) to provide on-call professional engineering services for multiple scopes of service on an as-needed basis under a basic task ordering agreement.The Offeror may choose to propose on one, all or any combination of the Scope of Services groups in which the Offeror has an interest. Competitive negotiations may result in awards to more than one offeror within each Scope of Services group. The criteria for award of these Scope of Services Contracts are defined in Section 10.0 below. The criteria for award of Project Task Orders (available to only those who have been awarded under the Scope of Service Contract) are further defined in Section 11.0.This solicitation is being issued as a competitive negotiation for professional services, in accordance with Virginia Code 2.2-4302.2 A.4.
